lines.say: Last night, I went back to Level Nine.
The door opened before I touched it.
Inside, a waiting room. Rows of empty chairs.
Every chair had a name on it. Mine was in the front row.
On the wall, a thousand badges. All blinking.
Mine blinked in time with them. Like one heartbeat.
The guard stood beside me. He did not hurt me. He said, you're late.
We have been waiting years for you.
Then he said, you were never an employee. You were chosen.
